data.title: Green Square
data.about:
An avant-garde and first-of-its-kind residential concept from Emaar, Green Square by Emaar offers a brilliant opportunity for you to get the best of both worlds by owning your dream workspace at the comfort of your own home.

Run Your Business at Your Luxury Residence, Boost your earning potential by running a thriving home-based business in one of the most vibrant global hubs for commerce. By paying 15% of the apartment price, you will obtain a FREE 3-year renewable family residency visa and a FREE 3-year renewable business license.

characteristics_module.title: Run Your Business at Your Luxury Residence
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Pay 15% & Get Free Renewable Family Residency Visa

  • Free 3-year renewable business license
  • 0% Personal & Corporate Interest
  • 60/40 post handover payment plan for 3 years
  • Business Café & Fully Equipped Gym

location_tile.title: Nestled inside Dubai Hills Estate
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Designed to create a bright future for entrepreneurs who dream to get the best of both worlds, Green Square features scenic views to Dubai Hills. It also offers the following conveniences to suit your dynamic lifestyle:

  • Dubai Hills Mall
  • Dubai Hills Boulevard
  • Hills Business Park
  • King’s College Hospital
  • Gems World Academy
  • Only 15 minutes to Downtown Dubai
  • Only 20 minutes to Dubai International Airport
